content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE PARAM (L53-93; header L46: define all fixed parameters). Sets the working real kind SP: 8 under DOUBLE_PRECISION with MPI_SP=MPI_DOUBLE_PRECISION under PARALLEL (L58-62), else SELECTED_REAL_KIND(6,30) with MPI_SP=MPI_REAL (L63-68). Declares physical/numerical PARAMETER constants (L71-80): pi, R_earth, SMALL, LARGE, grav, zero, air/water density ratios RHO_AW ('relative to water') and RHO_AIR ('absolute value'), RHO_WATER, DEG2RAD. Also declares module-global work variables shared across the code: loop indices I,J,K and RES (L83), integer temporaries itmp1-itmp5 (L84), real temporaries tmp1-tmp5 (L85). Under ITERATION: ITER_NUM=2 ('maximum iteration number of 2 like in Nwogu', comment L88) and convergence tolerance ERRORi=0.0001_SP (L87-91).
entities: SP INTEGER PARAMETER: 8 (DOUBLE_PRECISION, L59) or SELECTED_REAL_KIND(6,30) (L64)
MPI_SP INTEGER PARAMETER: MPI_DOUBLE_PRECISION (L61) or MPI_REAL (L66), PARALLEL only
pi, R_earth, SMALL, LARGE, grav, zero, RHO_AW, RHO_AIR, RHO_WATER, DEG2RAD REAL(SP) PARAMETERs (L71-80)
I, J, K, RES module-global INTEGERs (L83)
itmp1, itmp2, itmp3, itmp4, itmp5 module-global INTEGERs (L84)
tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, tmp4, tmp5 module-global REAL(SP)s (L85)
ITER_NUM INTEGER = 2, ERRORi REAL(SP) = 0.0001_SP (ITERATION only, L89-90)

verbatim_spans.text: !    PARAM is the module to define all fixed parameters
REAL(SP), PARAMETER:: RHO_AW = 0.0012041_SP  ! relative to water
! give a maximum iteration number of 2 like in Nwogu

unresolved: Cross-line/cross-file: I, J, K (L83) and tmp1-tmp5/itmp1-itmp5 (L84-85) are module-global work variables shared by every routine that USEs PARAM - this is where loop indices and temporaries (e.g. tmp3 used in mod_meteo.F) resolve; sharing loop indices across routines forbids OpenMP-style reentrancy.

pi=3.141592653 (L71) has no _SP kind suffix, so under DOUBLE_PRECISION it is a single-precision literal widened to REAL(8); DEG2RAD=0.0175 (L80) is a truncated pi/180=0.01745329 - both lower-accuracy than the other constants.
RES (L83) is declared but its role is not defined in this file.
DOUBLE_PRECISION branch sets SP=8 directly (L59) assuming kind 8 exists rather than using SELECTED_REAL_KIND - compiler-dependent assumption.
